source_links.label: Pay route regression on affected #300, lines 647–663

scope_boundary.later_final_cut_extension: Excluded from this validation; root is separately reviewing the later main/ref cut.

method_and_limits: Accounting and provenance validation only. Did not independently reread the approximately 210,000 scoped source lines.

Read Git objects and tree metadata, parsed audit JSON, checked hashes, counts, range coverage, and selected complete-diff bookkeeping. No target program, test, build, server, probe, package installer, transaction, or Git mutation was executed.
All count results are frozen to the report-input hashes and snapshot in report_validation. Later reports and refreshed provenance must be reconciled separately.
The per-row method text is a reviewer attestation. Identity and range checks do not independently prove that every line was semantically reviewed.

The broad lineage keyword scan is a discovery aid, not an error count: it also matches negative statements such as no diff inheritance and group methods that contain direct reads. The exact open provenance residual is 37 deduplicated pairs in audit-root-provenance-residual.json.
The static import closure is conservative and does not certify actual emitted bundle contents, runtime reachability, dependency advisories, deployed-origin behavior, or test pass status.

root_provenance_residual.scope: deduplicated first 54 review-root coverage records; excludes independent explicit full-read evidence in all current reports and supplemental read sections

evidence.method: Independent complete numbered read while screening generic error wording. No additional confirmed core issue.

discrepancies.title: Initial root rows do not distinguish direct full reads from counterpart/diff reads
discrepancies.evidence: The first 54 review-root.json coverage rows deduplicate to 42 path/blob pairs and share an either/or method. Five pairs have separate explicit full-read evidence. The other 37 pairs, totaling 5605 lines, have no separate accepted evidence in the reports examined.
discrepancies.repair: Refresh-read the 37 residual pairs, or a direct full baseline plus the complete diff for each dependent version, then write exact counterpart blobs and methods. Do not infer original read chronology. Root has assigned this repair.

discrepancies.title: Six portable-vault tests use prose instead of ref names
discrepancies.evidence: Six test-scope.json refs arrays contain Portable core vault test dependency. Their representative SHA:path/blob mappings and line counts are valid; the actual frozen-ref membership lists have 16, 28, 28, 28, 16 and 16 entries respectively. No path/blob variant is missing from the selected-path union.
discrepancies.repair: Move the prose to a scope_note and replace refs with the verified actual memberships in scope_union_validation.tests.membership_label_mismatches.

discrepancies.title: Consolidated test and repository copies are stale
discrepancies.evidence: At the 06:53:04 UTC report snapshot, reports support 509/535 test rows with 26 pending/3053 lines. Scratch reconciled tests still show 476 reviewed/59 pending, with 33 stale statuses. Repository source-scope still has 389 rows (382 production + 7 resources); scratch has 396 (389 + 7). Repository coverage-reconciled still has 339 production reviewed, 43 production pending and 7 resources pending.
discrepancies.repair: After the final reports and provenance repair arrive, rerun consolidation and synchronize final manifests, reports, pending lists and human summaries. Historical lane pending lists should be labeled historical and superseded by the consolidated ledger.

discrepancies.title: Source and test scopes overlap by one 46-line pair
discrepancies.evidence: packages/contracts/test/utils/ERC5564Announcer.sol at blob d862ca8a8b63d0bf898f5df829b38a83dbcf4493 appears in both scopes. Separate source/test category totals are legitimate. Their deduplicated combined scope is 930 path/blob pairs and 210696 version-lines, not 931 and 210742.
discrepancies.repair: State categories separately or subtract this one pair/46 lines from combined totals.

discrepancies.title: Reconciler stores weaker browser-custody provenance and does not validate full coverage itself
discrepancies.evidence: The browser-custody special case records version.notes as method and discards version.review_method. Coverage ingestion trusts status/path/blob without verifying object mapping, bounds or counterpart lineage. coverage-pending.json filters only production, so an empty file alone never establishes resource completion. Supplemental complete-read sections are ignored, although every currently scoped supplemental pair already has credit elsewhere.
discrepancies.repair: Preserve review_method, keep the independent validation results with the audit, and make pending summaries explicit by kind. No current malformed credited range or object mismatch was found; do not treat this script as an independent semantic review gate.

canonical_document_conclusions.source_link_validation: All 175 immutable GitHub source links resolve locally at the specified SHA/path; every line anchor is in bounds. This is local Git-object validation, not an HTTP reachability check.
canonical_document_conclusions.classification: Canonical register contains seven production findings: four medium and three low. The observations file explicitly keeps test qualification, existing hardening, trust boundaries and maintenance separate. No classification contradiction was identified in the canonical findings/observations reviewed.
canonical_document_conclusions.pay_route_correction: The canonical BROWSER-01 section expressly supersedes the earlier implication that the Pay route regression was absent. Preserve that correction when carrying raw lane reports forward.
canonical_document_conclusions.english_evidence: PN-05 includes the separately confirmed help.receiptFile instance as the same finding, not an eighth issue.
canonical_document_conclusions.unsafe_reproduction_text: No runnable exploit, crafted attack payload, or live reproduction procedure was identified in the canonical documents or report reproduction-related fields inspected. No reproduction was attempted.
canonical_document_conclusions.editorial_only: Some CP-K paragraphs are repeated verbatim in observations.md; this is harmless duplication and does not affect counts or classification.
